# `^`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
expr1 ^ expr2
```

Returns the result of bitwise exclusive OR of `expr1` and `expr2`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `bitwise_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- ^, example 1
> SELECT 3 ^ 5;
6
```
